cards.title: Pro Rank

ability.name: Starter perks
ability.text: Lobby particle ×1, [Pro] chat prefix, early 5th MineMart slot.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft item icon of a green rank badge, blocky, no text.

cards.title: Ace Rank

ability.name: Best deal
ability.text: Two lobby particles, [Ace] prefix, 100 bonus Victory Coins, extra ranked maps.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft item icon of a gold ace rank badge, blocky, no text.

cards.title: Legend Rank

ability.name: Top tier
ability.text: Three particles, [Legend] prefix, 1000 bonus coins, most ranked maps.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft item icon of an orange legend crown, blocky, no text.

cards.title: Victory Coins

ability.name: Server currency
ability.text: Spend on kits, extra inventory, and lobby cosmetics. Also earned by playing.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft painting of a brown coin pouch with a V mark, blocky, no readable text.

cards.title: Survive Disasters

ability.name: Disaster rounds
ability.text: Survive shifting hazards. Ranked maps can appear when a ranked player is in the game.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft scene of players running from a meteor, blocky, no text.

cards.title: MineMart

ability.name: Infinite store
ability.text: Shop-crawl minigame. Ranks unlock the 5th inventory slot early.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft infinite supermarket interior, blocky, no text.
